title: Conditional κ = 7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴: 91 collective response-kernel families on helpers untouched by #283, at its own cut (+0.0248% over #283)
body:
# Conditional κ = 7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴: 91 collective response-kernel families on helpers untouched by #283, at its own cut (+0.0248% over #283)

One self-contained package, `research/gen4-collective-families-283/` (PR #283's package with 91 rows appended, one contained block in its bank allocator, regenerated receipts), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**κ = 181572923056461298166587/(25·10²⁵) = 7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴** by #283's fixed-prime price, +1.80·10⁻⁷ over #283's 7.26111344123733·10⁻⁴ and +0.473% over #276's gen4 word; the bit side binds.

## Result

A census of the 13,944 plain dirty helpers of the gen4 word (12,352 distinct complete F₂ target responses of rank 1,760) enumerates the low-weight F₂ circuits among the responses — 1,616 twin pairs, 5,245 triples, 38,633 quadruples after twin expansion — keeps those with a nondegenerate common entrance inside all members' first required frames (616 / 1,131 / 4,490), prices them under the deficit-fixed ledger (φ(r) = r·ln(120/r); a quintuple is never net-positive) and packs them greedily with shared donors on nested chains. On the bare gen4 word this gives a 695-entry selection (416 pairs, 24 twin pairs entering on 16-dimensional intersections, 255 multi-donor families; model κ 7.24029·10⁻⁴ before any retiming), whose helpers largely coincide with #283's 741-pivot selection. On helpers that no part of #283 touches (its 1,612 kernel roles, 16 sinks, 60 transported candidates), **91 families remain net-positive — 87 quadruples and 4 triples**: (3, 3, 3, 3) with e = 2 × 49, (5, 5, 5, 5) with e = 4 × 10, families of first dimension 10–17 entering on e = r − 1 or r − 2; entrance rank 456, 14 donors shared. All are legal at #283's global cut 520,031, so they are appended to `inputs/kernel-original.json` in #283's schema and go through its sink remap and kernel transform unchanged.

| | #283 | this package |
|---|---:|---:|
| kernel pivots / entrance rank (with transports) | 741 / 2,074 | **832 / 2,530** |
| one-stage paid rank mass | 425,358 → 422,844 | 425,358 → **422,388** |
| literal stock (120 replicas) / normalized | 2,551,580 / 510,316 | **2,549,300 / 509,860** |
| κ (fixed-prime price) | 7.26111344123733·10⁻⁴ | **7.26291692225845·10⁻⁴** |

The ledger model predicted #283's price → 7.26291688·10⁻⁴; the package's pricers give exactly that before the fixed-prime refinement.

## The one code change (PROOF.md, section 3)

#283's `code/banks.cpp` tiles a residual-r role with four r-blocks and (30 − r) rank-4 fillers per bank; the 91 families need 30,060 rank-4 filler copies where #283's word leaves 10,380. The allocator now lets a residual group that would exhaust the rank-4 pool use rank-3 fillers instead (4r + 4b + 12k = 120 with b = (30 − r) mod 3), both remainders and the pool asserted, every bank width 120 and full; when the pool suffices the allocation is byte for byte #283's. Here only #283's own 29 rank-19 transported entrances switch (pattern [6 × 4, 3 × 32] in 870 banks; 3⁴⁰ banks 2,118 → 1,422). Without the change, 25 of the families fit the pool and give 7.26226544·10⁻⁴ (rows kept in `discovery/`).

## Checks

#283's verifier, otherwise unchanged, end to end: the nine #276 stages on the vendored immutable package; sink transform and audit; kernel transform (832 pivots, 13,136 compensation reads removed, 3,462 Q/Q⁻¹ gates, all 19,914 columns forward and inverse, omitted-operation controls non-vacuous); #279's retiming (880 gates), #280's transports (29) and restorations (440), the 220 target squares; independent legality and prefix audits (1,464,320 kernel equalities on 1,956 helpers); 23,434 global columns; bank review with the new allocation (4,923,000 assignments, chart bound unchanged, max 312 factors); price, fixed-prime price (47 constraints, adjacent grid rejected) and finite invoice; every receipt regenerated and pinned. The families were also replayed on the bare gen4 word with per-family omitted-setup and omitted-restore controls (`discovery/replay_families.py`).

## Verify

    sudo apt-get install -y g++ libboost-dev
    python -m pip install -r research/gen4-collective-families-283/requirements.txt    # sympy 1.14.0
    python3 -B research/gen4-collective-families-283/verify.py --output /tmp/gen4-collective-replay   # about 16 minutes locally; fresh directory outside the package

Prints the certificate `PASS_SOURCE_REGENERATED_COMPOSITION` with κ. The workflow runs it on Ubuntu with Python 3.11 and 3.13.

## Scope and limits

* Same conditional status as #276/#283 (finite construction under the retained public all-size hypotheses; no Lean certificate); #283's own correctness claims are inherited, not re-proved.
* The 24 e = 16 twin pairs and most multi-donor families of the bare-word selection sit on helpers #283 already uses and were not re-derived on its word; per-family cuts were not needed (all 91 are legal at the global cut).
* Diff against #283's package (`discovery/README.md`): `inputs/kernel-original.json` (+91 rows), `inputs/kernel-remapped.json`, `code/banks.cpp` (filler block), one sentence in `PROOF-PR283.md`, regenerated `expected/` and `RESULT.json`, `MANIFEST.json`, this package's notes and `discovery/`.

## Credits

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial Anthropic Claude assistance. Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`. The composed word, the donor-first kernel selection, sinks, audits, pricers and the bank allocator extended here are Dugongue's (#283, on #254/#259/#272); the gen4 word is DreamingOfClouds' (#276); the retimings and target squares are rohanarun's (#279); the transports and restorations are utcorvusvolat-dotcom's (#280); the target-prefix mechanism is eumemic's (#268) on its source527 five-stage lineage; the five-stage layout is hcg890's (#234) with Jacob Sussman's construction. This package contributes the collective-kernel census, the 91 families, the rank-3 filler block, the receipts and the discovery scripts.
